2088. Swapping Two Numbers Without Using a Third Variable

40

Medium

Problem Statement
Read two integers and exchange (swap) their values without using any third (temporary) variable, then print the swapped values.

Description
Read two integers a and b from input. Exchange the values of a and b using only arithmetic operators (+ and -), without declaring a third variable. Print the new value of a followed by the new value of b. This uses only variables, assignment statements, and printf/scanf — no loops or conditions are needed.
input_spec:
. Exchange the values of a and b using only arithmetic operators (+ and -), without declaring a third variable. Print the new value of a followed by the new value of b. This uses only variables, assignment statements, and printf/scanf — no loops or conditions are needed.

Input Description
Two integers a and b separated by a space.
output_spec: Print the swapped value of a, then the swapped value of b, each on its own line.
